kinds.description: A saved view opening one record. v1 string patterns and lengths (uuid v4/v7 ids, app/format patterns, 1-60 code-point names) are NOT enforced by the store in this revision; they must be enforced by a Foci consumer, and store-level text formats are pending. Cardinality one on member_of is not enforced by the store; one Focus per view belongs to a Foci consumer. No audience-change guard exists yet: a write is not fenced against a concurrent change to the home's access policy.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Human name shown in the sidebar. v1's name limits must be enforced by a Foci consumer; this package does not enforce them. The interpreter's 4,096-byte text ceiling still applies.

fields.name: definition
fields.description: The pinned view definition: which app opens which record.

fields.name: app
fields.description: Owning app id. The pattern must be enforced by a Foci consumer; this package does not enforce it. The interpreter's 4,096-byte text ceiling still applies.

fields.name: target
fields.description: The record this view opens.

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Target record id. The shape must be enforced by a Foci consumer; this package does not enforce it. The interpreter's 4,096-byte text ceiling still applies.
